data.description: Your to-do list: tasks with a due day or time and a priority, sorted into task lists in your own order. Substrate Tasks keeps them.

Something you have to do, such as Buy milk or Renew passport, with when it is due and how urgent it is. It is in one of your task lists or in none, and stays open until you mark it done or abandon it.

name.description: what to do, in one line, such as Buy milk

url.description: a link that goes with the task, such as the page to read or the form to fill in

list.description: the task list it is in; absent when it is in none, which Substrate Tasks shows as its inbox

position.description: where the task sits among the tasks of its list, lowest first; a number written as a string, such as "2" or "1.5"

dueDay.description: the day it is due; written on every task with a due date, timed or not

priority.description: how urgent it is, from none to urgent

status.description: open until you mark it done or abandon it; either can be undone. A suggested task waits as proposed until you add or dismiss it

data.description: A task list: a named list of your tasks, such as Groceries or Home, kept in the order you arrange your lists. A task is in one list or in none.

name.description: the list's name, such as Groceries

position.description: where the list sits among your lists, lowest first; a number written as a string, such as "2" or "1.5"

data.description: How Substrate Tasks shows one collection of your tasks: whether it is on, what it groups by, and which of its properties the app reads as the due date, the priority and the order.

kind.description: the collection's kind, by its full reference, such as substrate.reamde.dev/tasks/task

enabled.description: whether Substrate Tasks shows the collection

group.description: the reference the collection's tasks are grouped by; absent for the app's guess, `-` for none

due.description: the property read as the due time; absent for the app's guess, `-` for none

dueDay.description: the property read as the due day; absent for the app's guess, `-` for none

priority.description: the property read as the priority; absent for the app's guess, `-` for none

order.description: the property read as the owner's order; absent for the app's guess, `-` for none

data.description: Your choices across every collection Substrate Tasks shows: where new tasks go, and the groups you pinned, in your order.

newTasks.description: the kind new tasks are written to, by its full reference; absent for substrate.reamde.dev/tasks/task

pins.description: the groups you pinned, in your order
